verdict.rationale: Greptile's documented self-hosted deployment lets customers keep data in their own infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, on-premises VPC, or air-gapped), with logs stored only on customer servers, so residency is controllable through self-hosting. Nothing in the evidence shows region selection for the hosted SaaS. missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted cloud service, a documented list of data-storage regions, independent corroboration of residency guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Deploy Greptile in your own infrastructure with Docker Compose. Supports AWS, GCP, Azure, air-gapped environments, and custom LLM configurations.
in the self-hosted service, logs are stored on customer servers only.
